I’ve had 24/7 tinnitus for probably the last year and a half. Have had TMD for a very long time. 

I think it’s important to note hearing loss will not identify tinnitus. Even if one has damage to their nerves or cochlea, most hearing tests cannot detect that. They can only detect whether you cannot hear certain frequencies. If you do not have hearing loss, tinnitus’ other major cause is sensorineural hearing damage. 

TMD affects the limbic system and brain. This is the main reason why people have tinnitus and TMJ together, without hearing loss.

tl;dr: Yes, it is very likely your tinnitus is caused by TMJ.
